task: Find the top game listed in the Steam Deck's top-played list over the past year. Then, browse reviews for that game from players who have played over 100 hours and primarily use a Steam Deck.
agent_final_answer:
The top game listed in the Steam Deck's top-played list over the past year is **Slay the Spire 2** (#1 rank on the Steam Deck Top Played chart for the past year, ahead of Stardew Valley and Hades II).

---

### Reviews from Players with >100 Hours Who Primarily Play on Steam Deck

Applying the review filters **"Over 100 hours"** playtime and **"Played mostly on Steam Deck"** yielded the following top reviews:

1. **DirtyEarsBill** (Recommended — 881.1 hrs on record / 742.3 hrs at review time)
   - *"This may be my favorite game of all time. I'm stunned at how I never feel fatigue in playing it. When one run ends, I just start another. My appreciation of the game only deepens the more I play it. That's usually not a thing. Each run feels unique. It's crazy what a masterclass of a game this is, like there should be college courses based around this game. It is greater than the sum of its parts."*

2. **Pete** (Recommended — 332.9 hrs on record / 326.4 hrs at review time)
   - *"This is an excellent sequel and a great game overall. They have really improved on the first game. They've added mechanics both for the player and the enemies. Added card features. Improved game choices. Overall made the game more interesting. And they are still actively patching the game and bringing out new features, which is great to see. I do recommend."*

3. **bishmuuth** (Recommended — 325.3 hrs on record / 303.7 hrs at review time)
   - *"This is the most I've played any game other than Minecraft, which has a fair headstart given I picked it up in 2011. I'm not a 'devoted to one game' gamer typically, so this one is special."*

4. **Rosetta Stoned** (Recommended — 306.1 hrs on record / 291.3 hrs at review time)
   - Praises the game's progress in Early Access/Beta and the uniqueness of the characters and builds. However, notes that higher difficulties can have punishing path RNG, and feels characters like The Regent and Necrobinder have fewer consistent viable builds compared to others.

5. **<<NEET>>** (Not Recommended — 281.2 hrs on record)
   - *"The game seems to keep getting worse and worse with every update. Balance is pretty atrocious now, and is just legitimately not fun now in either singleplayer or multiplayer."*

6. **Gaming Baby** (Recommended — 253.1 hrs on record / 247.7 hrs at review time)
   - Calls it likely their favorite game of all time once fully released: *"Worth your time, worth your money. Learning this game feels like learning a foreign language. The individual pieces are fairly intuitive, but stringing everything together into a cohesive run takes knowledge, intent, and lots and lots of practice. Would recommend this to anyone who likes learning new things, or honestly just good video games."*

7. **poumghi** (Recommended — 240.2 hrs on record / 164.9 hrs at review time)
   - *"Amazing game. Addictive, funny, coopérative, no stress induced. Highly recommend. Hoping for more about this game to come out!"*

8. **Genuis0481** (Recommended — 239.4 hrs on record / 223.8 hrs at review time)
   - *"Sometimes it feels very random. But the more I played the more I learned it was a skill issue (my skill). Sticking with it I have got better and better."*

9. **wolf.austin** (Recommended — 199.8 hrs on record / 161.6 hrs at review time)
   - Highlights the addictive gameplay loop and how fun the new multiplayer mode is to play with others.

10. **Spazhazard** (Recommended — 151.9 hrs on record / 150.1 hrs at review time)
    - *"They took a perfect game and then they did a part 2 and made it a second perfect game (in progress)."*

---

### Key Takeaways from Long-Time Steam Deck Players
- **High Replayability & Addiction:** Players with several hundred hours report virtually zero burnout, frequently calling it one of their favorite games ever and a natural fit for handheld play.
- **Sequel Improvements & Multiplayer:** The addition of co-op/multiplayer, new card mechanics, and distinct character mechanics are widely commended.
- **Balance & Difficulty Nuances:** While overwhelmingly positive, experienced players note ongoing Early Access balance changes and high-difficulty path/seed RNG as current areas of focus for developer balancing.

const reviewElements = await browserjs(tabId, () => {
  // Find all elements that mention "hrs on record"
  const allElements = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('*'));
  const reviewCards = allElements.filter(el => {
    return el.innerText && el.innerText.includes('hrs on record') && el.children.length < 15 && el.tagName === 'DIV';
  });
  
  // Or check for review text
  const reviews = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('[class*="review"], [class*="Review"]'))
    .map(el => ({
      className: el.className,
      id: el.id,
      text: el.innerText?.slice(0, 100)
    }))
    .filter(x => x.text && (x.text.includes('hrs') || x.text.includes('Recommended')));

  return {
    reviewCardsText: reviewCards.map(c => c.innerText.slice(0, 200)),
    reviews: reviews.slice(0, 10)
  };
});

console.log("Review elements:", JSON.stringify(reviewElements, null, 2));
